description: This Java class 'TorqueCalculator' provides a method to calculate torque based on RPM, horsepower, and measurement units (imperial or metric). It uses constants imported from a Constants class to perform the calculation, suggesting it is part of a larger project related to vehicle or engine data processing.

classes.name: TorqueCalculator
classes.description: Provides a static method to calculate torque from rpm, horsepower, and units, utilizing constants for unit-specific calculations.

methods.name: calculateTorque
